slides.works_in: Any blue deck. Best on turn one.
slides.hook: One blue mana. Every noncreature spell they cast either draws you a card or costs them four.

reasons.text: Turn one Remora in a four-player pod is usually three or four cards before it goes away.
The four-mana tax isn't a real choice early. Nobody has it spare on turn two.
Treat it like a tempo spell, not a fixture. Let it go once it has paid for itself.

slides.watch_out: Cumulative upkeep. One mana, then two, then three. Decide early which turn you stop paying.

slides.question: How many cards does Remora usually get you before you let it die?
